notes: Unit of analysis: subject (one value per subject); trials are never treated as independent clinical samples.
rank_biserial_r > 0 means the HC subject-level median is larger.
These comparisons are descriptive; no multiple-comparison correction is applied and no diagnostic validity is claimed.

results.description: median of per-trial median fixation durations (ms)
mean center-of-mass distance from map center (cells)

HC.rule: subject with median total fixations in group, trial with median fixation-density mass in that subject

SZ.rule: subject with median total fixations in group, trial with median fixation-density mass in that subject
